result:
Correction applied, `make verify` passes, committed, tree clean.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/core/errors.py` — `client_error_handler` now takes the request; when the path starts with `/v1` it keeps the mapped status and code but answers a fixed per-code sentence from `_PUBLIC_AWS_MESSAGES` ("AWS resource not found", "AWS rejected the request as invalid", "AWS access denied", "AWS is throttling this request", "AWS resource conflict") with `detail = {"aws_error_code": …}` only. Console `/api` routes are unchanged (stripped AWS text plus `operation`). Docstring extended with the boundary rationale.
- `backend/tests/test_errors_aws.py` — new `/v1/aws/{code}` route in the throwaway app; `test_public_api_gets_a_generic_message_and_no_operation` raises the same AccessDeniedException (message carrying a role ARN and instance id) on `/api` and `/v1` and asserts the `/v1` body contains neither the raw text, `arn:aws`, the instance id, nor `operation`, while the `/api` body has all of them; parametrized `test_every_public_code_has_a_generic_message` covers each `aws.*` code on `/v1`.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — the sentence saying `/v1` and `/api` share the envelopes now states `/v1` returns the same status and code but a generic message and `aws_error_code`-only detail, and why.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `/v1` redaction in `client_error_handler`: mapped status + code kept, generic per-code message, `detail` = `{aws_error_code}` only; `/api` keeps the full stripped message and `operation`.
- ✅ Hermetic test in `backend/tests/test_errors_aws.py` mounting an `/api`-style and a `/v1/...` route raising the same AccessDeniedException; `/v1` body has neither the raw message nor `operation`, `/api` body has both. Passes.
- ✅ `docs/api.md` + `docs/api.zh-CN.md` sentence updated to say the `/v1` message is generic.
- ✅ `make verify` passes; tree clean; committed on the branch.
- Previously accepted checks (hermetic tests, live curl on the console routes, locale keys, screenshots, architecture docs) are untouched by this pass; the host's own rerun confirmed them.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- The `/v1` check is a path-prefix test on `request.url.path` inside the handler, as instructed, rather than a separate handler registration on the public router. `PUBLIC_API_PREFIX` is a module constant so the prefix lives in one place.
- No live `/v1` curl was run: producing an AWS ClientError on the invoke path needs a real agent and an API key, and the hermetic test pins the exact body shape. The console-route live results from pass 1 are unaffected.
- The architecture docs were not touched; they describe the mapping table, which did not change. Only the API docs carried the `/v1` sharing sentence.

## 5. Commits

```
aff9095 fix(errors): generic AWS error messages on /v1 — no role ARN or operation across the API-key boundary
a6d61c2 fix(errors): map unanticipated AWS ClientErrors to 4xx envelopes, never a bare 500
```
